title: torcul/job-request/1
description: Job request contract (`torcul/job-request/1`) written by a caller to trigger `torcul`.

rollback_days.description: Days to retain the swapped-out original as a rollback copy; defaults to 7.

rule.description: Effective rule resolved by the caller.

source.description: Path to the library media file.

staging_root.description: Staging root directory on the same filesystem device as `source`.

title.description: Title facts needed by the policy planner (original language and anime flag).

Mode.description: Execution depth requested for a job (`plan`, `stage` or `apply`).

RequestSchema.description: Schema identifier for a version 1 job request (`"torcul/job-request/1"`).

RequestTitle.description: Title facts the caller resolves for the policy planner; unknown fields are refused.

original.description: ISO 639 code of the title's original language, if known.

Rule.description: Effective processing rule resolved by the caller for this library item.

TrackRule.description: Effective track-selection rule resolved by the caller.

languages.description: ISO 639 language codes to keep; at least one.
